But behind all that wreckage, there’s a new gold mine for the defense sector. The data drones generate will far outlast the wars in which they are used to fight, 来源：MIT Technology Review AI

Perplexity Details Its GPU Embedding Stack: How Ivy, Tulip and ROSE Serve pplx-embed 摘要：人工智能搜索产品的检索质量受到两件事的限制：嵌入模型有多好，以及在索引中运行它的成本有多低。本周，Perplexity Engineering 团队发布了《GPU 上的快速嵌入》，这是第二个项目背后的服务基础设施的幕后说明。

原文：Retrieval quality in an AI search product is bounded by two things: how good the embedding model is, and how cheaply you can run it across an index. This week, Perplexity Engineering team published Fast Embeddings on GPUs, an under-the-hood account of the second — the serving infrastructure behind p 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Nous Research Adds One-Click Local Model Setup to Hermes Desktop 摘要：Nous Research 将本地模型设置压缩为只需在 Hermes Desktop 中单击即可。该应用程序读取您的硬件，根据您的 GPU 检查目录，选择适合的最高质量构建，下载它，并配置 llama.cpp — 具有硬 4 位底层和 64K 最小上下文窗口。这

原文：Nous Research has collapsed local model setup into a single click in Hermes Desktop. The app reads your hardware, fit-checks the catalog against your GPU, picks the highest-quality build that fits, downloads it, and configures llama.cpp — with a hard 4-bit floor and a 64K minimum context window. The 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：We look at Project HydraFusion, GitHub's research preview that treats workflow selection as an optimization problem rather than a model picker. We break down the three execution patterns it routes between — Single, Cascade with a quality gate, and Critique with a read-only cross-family reviewer. The 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：Most web applications still have no structured way for an AI agent to register. auth.md proposes a fix: a Markdown file apps publish at their domain that tells agents which registration flows are supported, which scopes to request, and how to get credentials tied to a real user — without a human fil 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Together AI 开源 OSCAR：用于长上下文 LLM 服务的注意力感知 2 位 KV 缓存量化系统
docs.text:

Google Research Adds Agentic RAG to Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with a Sufficient Context Agent for multi-hop queries 摘要：Google Research 详细介绍了 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 中的代理 RAG 框架。充分的上下文代理会重新搜索，直到多跳、多源查询有足够的基础来回答。与标准 RAG 相比，该框架将事实准确性提高了 34%。谷歌研究的帖子添加了Ag

原文：Google Research details an agentic RAG framework in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. A Sufficient Context Agent re-searches until multi-hop, multi-source queries have enough grounding to answer. The framework raises factuality accuracy up to 34% versus standard RAG. The post Google Research Adds Ag 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：Flash-KMeans is an open-source, IO-aware implementation of standard Lloyd's k-means in Triton GPU kernels. It does not change the math or approximate. FlashAssign removes distance-matrix materialization; Sort-Inverse Update eliminates atomic contention. On an NVIDIA H200, it reports 17.9× end-to-end 来源：MarkTechPost

The 7 Types of Agent Memory: A Technical Guide for AI Engineers 摘要：默认情况下，法学硕士是无国籍的。代理内存解决了这个问题。本指南细分了所有 7 种类型——工作型、语义型、情景型、程序型、检索型、参数型和前瞻性。它涵盖了每个商店的内容、所在位置以及何时建造。包括比较表和工作 Python 代码。职位

原文：LLMs are stateless by default. Agent memory fixes that. This guide breaks down all 7 types — working, semantic, episodic, procedural, retrieval, parametric, and prospective. It covers what each stores, where it lives, and when to build it. Includes a comparison table and working Python code. The pos 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Interfaze 推出 diffusive-gemma-asr-small，这是一个开源 Diffusion ASR 模型，通过 DiffusionGemma 的并行去噪解码器转录六种语言
docs.text:
Interfaze Ships diffusion-gemma-asr-small, an Open-Source Diffusion ASR Model Transcribing Six Languages via DiffusionGemma’s Parallel Denoising Decoder 摘要：Interfaze 开源扩散-gemma-asr-small，一种通过扩散而不是自回归进行转录的多语言 ASR 模型。它使用约 42M 参数适配器将音频添加到 Google 的冻结 DiffusionGemma。一个适配器涵盖六种语言，转录成本由去噪步骤设置，而不是转录

原文：Interfaze open-sourced diffusion-gemma-asr-small, a multilingual ASR model that transcribes via diffusion, not autoregression. It adds audio to Google's frozen DiffusionGemma using a ~42M-parameter adapter. One adapter covers six languages, with transcription cost set by denoising steps, not transcr 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: RAG-Anything 教程：在 Colab 中构建文本、表格、方程和图像的多模态检索管道
docs.text:
RAG-Anything Tutorial: Build a Multimodal Retrieval Pipeline for Text, Tables, Equations, and Images in Colab 摘要：在本教程中，我们构建一个 RAG-Anything 工作流程来探索多模式检索如何跨文本、表格、方程和图像工作。我们准备一个 Colab 环境，在运行时输入 OpenAI API 密钥，并生成包含图表和 PDF 的综合报告。我们将该内容转换为 RAG-Anythin

原文：In this tutorial, we build a RAG-Anything workflow to explore how multimodal retrieval works across text, tables, equations, and images. We prepare a Colab environment, enter our OpenAI API key at runtime, and generate a synthetic report with a chart and PDF. We convert that content into RAG-Anythin 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Meet WebBrain: An Open-Source, Local-First AI Browser Agent That Reads Pages and Automates Tasks in Chrome and Firefox 摘要：WebBrain 是一款获得 MIT 许可的免费 AI 浏览器代理，适用于 Chrome 和 Firefox。它读取页面、提取数据并通过“询问”和“行动”模式自动执行多步骤任务。在 llama.cpp 或 Ollama 等本地模型上运行以保护隐私，或连接任何云 API。文章认识 WebBrain：开源、本地首创

原文：WebBrain is a free, MIT-licensed AI browser agent for Chrome and Firefox. It reads pages, extracts data, and automates multi-step tasks through Ask and Act modes. Run it on local models like llama.cpp or Ollama for privacy, or connect any cloud API. The post Meet WebBrain: An Open-Source, Local-Firs 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：Mistral AI released Leanstral 1.5, a free Apache-2.0 code agent model for Lean 4. It saturates miniF2F and solves 587 of 672 PutnamBench problems. The 119B mixture-of-experts activates 6.5B parameters per token. We break down its architecture, benchmarks, real bug-finding case studies, and deploymen 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: NVIDIA 发布 Audex (Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B)：保留其骨干文本智能的统一音频文本 LLM
docs.text:
NVIDIA Releases Audex (Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B): A Unified Audio-Text LLM That Preserves the Text Intelligence of Its Backbone 摘要：NVIDIA 的 Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B 将音频理解、语音识别、翻译、TTS 和音频生成统一在一个 MoE 模型中。它通过边际回归保留了 Nemotron-Cascade-2 主干的文本智能。 NVIDIA 发布 Audex (Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B) 后：A U

原文：NVIDIA's Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B unifies audio understanding, speech recognition, translation, TTS, and audio generation in one MoE model. It keeps the text intelligence of its Nemotron-Cascade-2 backbone with marginal regression. The post NVIDIA Releases Audex (Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B): A U 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Liquid AI Open-Sources Antidoom: A Final Token Preference Optimization (FTPO) Method that Reduces Doom Loops in Reasoning Models 摘要：Liquid AI 发布了 Antidoom，这是一种针对推理模型中的厄运循环的开源方法。末日循环会重复一个跨度，直到上下文窗口耗尽。 Antidoom 找到启动循环的令牌，并使用最终令牌偏好优化 (FTPO) 仅重新训练该位置。在 LFM2.5-

原文：Liquid AI released Antidoom, an open-source method that targets doom loops in reasoning models. A doom loop repeats a span until the context window is exhausted. Antidoom finds the token that starts the loop and retrains only that position using Final Token Preference Optimization (FTPO). On LFM2.5- 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Robbyant Releases LingBot-VLA 2.0: An Open-Source 6B Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Model for Cross-Embodiment Robot Manipulation 摘要：蚂蚁集团的 Robbyant 发布了 LingBot-VLA 2.0，这是一种用于跨实体机器人操作的 Apache-2.0 视觉-语言-动作模型。 6B 检查点基于大约 60,000 小时的数据进行预训练，涵盖 20 种机器人配置的 50,000 小时的机器人轨迹和 10,000 小时的 egoce

原文：Ant Group's Robbyant has released LingBot-VLA 2.0, an Apache-2.0 vision-language-action model for cross-embodiment robot manipulation. The 6B checkpoint is pretrained on roughly 60,000 hours of data, spanning 50,000 hours of robot trajectories across 20 robot configurations and 10,000 hours of egoce 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Netflix AI 团队通过按 ID 拆分 Cassandra 分区，将宽分区读取延迟从几秒缩短至几毫秒
docs.text:
Netflix AI Team Cuts Wide-Partition Read Latency from Seconds to Milliseconds by Splitting Cassandra Partitions Per ID 摘要：Netflix 工程师详细介绍了他们如何在 Apache Cassandra 中处理 TimeSeries 抽象的宽分区。两种方法协同工作：时间片重新分区在表级别调整未来分区，而动态分区则检测并分割每个 TimeSeries ID 上的过大分区。

原文：Netflix engineers detailed how they handle wide partitions in Apache Cassandra for the TimeSeries Abstraction. Two approaches work together: Time Slice re-partitioning tunes future partitions at the table level, while dynamic partitioning detects and splits oversized partitions per TimeSeries ID on 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：Google AI Studio is rolling out Import from GitHub in Build mode. It transforms an existing repo into a runtime-compatible format. You can then iterate on it, deploy it, and more. The post Google AI Studio Adds Import from GitHub to Build a Deployable App appeared first on MarkTechPost. 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6（Sol、Terra、Luna）：一个三层模型系列，在响应 API 中提供编程工具调用
docs.text:
OpenAI Releases GPT-5.6 (Sol, Terra, Luna): A Three-Tier Model Family With Programmatic Tool Calling in the Responses API 摘要：OpenAI 于 2026 年 7 月 9 日将 GPT-5.6 全面发布，推出了三层而不是一层模型。 Sol 的价格为每 100 万个代币 5 美元/30 美元，Terra 的价格为 2.50 美元/15 美元，Luna 的价格为 1 美元/6 美元。 Sol 将人工分析编码代理指数设置为 80，比 Claude Fable 5 高出 2.8 个点，在 OSWorld 2.0 us 上达到 62.6%

原文：OpenAI moved GPT-5.6 to general availability on July 9, 2026, shipping three tiers instead of one model. Sol is $5/$30 per 1M tokens, Terra is $2.50/$15, and Luna is $1/$6. Sol sets the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index at 80, 2.8 points above Claude Fable 5, and reaches 62.6% on OSWorld 2.0 us 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: NeuroVFM：一种新的神经影像基础模型，使用 Vol-JEPA 在未经策划的临床 MRI 和 CT 体积上进行训练
docs.text:
Meet NeuroVFM: A New Neuroimaging Foundation Model Trained With Vol-JEPA on Uncurated Clinical MRI and CT Volumes 摘要：NeuroVFM 是来自密歇根大学的通用神经影像基础模型，经过 524 万临床 MRI 和 CT 体积的训练。其 Vol-JEPA 基础将 I-JEPA 和 V-JEPA 扩展到体积医学成像，无需放射学报告标签即可学习大脑解剖学和病理学。认识 NeuroVF 后

原文：NeuroVFM is a generalist neuroimaging foundation model from the University of Michigan, trained on 5.24M clinical MRI and CT volumes. Its Vol-JEPA base extends I-JEPA and V-JEPA to volumetric medical imaging, learning brain anatomy and pathology without radiology-report labels. The post Meet NeuroVF 来源：MarkTechPost

Meet Shepherd: An Open-Source Python Substrate That Lets Meta-Agents Fork, Replay, and Revert Any Agent Run 摘要：长时间代理运行累积状态，没有记录记录 - 编辑的文件、实时开发服务器、安装的软件包、温暖的提示缓存。当代理在第 10 步误读回溯并重写正确的文件时，向前修补会消耗代币并重新启动，并重新支付每个调用的费用。东北研究人员

原文：Long agent runs accumulate state that no transcript records — edited files, a live dev server, installed packages, a warm prompt cache. Google AI Just Released Gemini 3.7 Flash: A Coding and Agent Model at $0.75/1M Input Tokens 摘要：Google 发布了 Gemini 3.7 Flash，它是 Gemini 3.6 Flash 的改进版，对其推理核心进行了算法改进。它跨 1M 令牌上下文窗口处理文本、图像、音频和视频，并具有 64K 令牌输出，并支持可定制的思维配置。编码结果显着变化

原文：Google has released Gemini 3.7 Flash, a refinement of Gemini 3.6 Flash with algorithmic improvements to its reasoning core. It handles text, images, audio, and video across a 1M-token context window with 64K-token output, and supports customizable thinking configurations. Coding results move notably 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-VL-3B: A 3B Vision-Language Model That Reads Screens, Grounds Objects, and Calls Tools On-Device 摘要：Liquid AI 发布了 LFM2.5-VL-3B，这是一种专为设备上部署而构建的 3.1B 参数视觉语言模型。它在 ScreenSpot-v2 上的平均得分为 80.7，并将 RefCOCO 的得分从 57.1 提升至 87.9。函数调用是 VL 系列的新增功能，ToolSandbox 从 26.4 移至 59.5。该模型大约可容纳 3 GB

原文：Liquid AI released LFM2.5-VL-3B, a 3.1B-parameter vision-language model built for on-device deployment. It averages 80.7 on ScreenSpot-v2 and lifts RefCOCO grounding from 57.1 to 87.9. Function calling is new to the VL line, with ToolSandbox moving from 26.4 to 59.5. The model fits in roughly 3 GB a 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：MiniMax released MiniMax-Music3, an open-weights text-to-music model. Given lyrics with section tags and a structured caption, it generates a complete song of up to five minutes in a single pass, as 32 kHz, 16-bit stereo WAV. Here is the architecture, the three serving paths, and the license conditi 来源：MarkTechPost

原文：“Runaway” AI, “rogue” agents, and “autonomous” actors—the current rhetoric would have you believe that AI agents are not only awake and aware, but angry at their creators. Prominent tech leaders such as Demis Hassabis, Dario Amodei, and Sam Altman push for regulation of these seemingly “superhuman” 来源：MIT Technology Review AI

原文：PDFs are easy to read and hard to change. AI can now summarize a 90-page contract in seconds, but it still won't rewrite the source file cleanly. docs.text:

原文：“Runaway” AI, “rogue” agents, and “autonomous” actors—the current rhetoric would have you believe that AI agents are not only awake and aware, but angry at their creators. Prominent tech leaders such as Demis Hassabis, Dario Amodei, and Sam Altman push for regulation of these seemingly “superhuman” 来源：MIT Technology Review AI

docs.text:
Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio 摘要：在文本转语音过程中，速度和准确性通常是相互矛盾的。 Gradium AI 的新默认模型报告了这两项内容：五种语言的 500 个硬句子的人工评分通过率为 81.0%，Coval 上的 P50 首个音频时间为 216 毫秒。评估集在 CC BY 4.0 下在 Hugging Face 上开放。该 p

原文：Speed and accuracy usually pull against each other in text-to-speech. Gradium AI's new default model reports both: an 81.0% human-rated pass rate on 500 hard sentences across five languages, at 216 ms P50 time-to-first-audio on Coval. The evaluation set is open on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0. The p 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: 谷歌AI发布TimesFM-3：用于多元时间序列预测的330M参数零样本基础模型
docs.text:
Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting 摘要：Google Research 发布了 TimesFM-3，这是一个 3.3 亿参数的时间序列基础模型，可在一次前向传递中预测多个相关序列。与 2.5 版之前的每个 TimesFM 检查点不同，它是针对多变量预测进行本地预训练的，接受多个目标、过去的协变量

原文：Google Research has released TimesFM-3, a 330 million parameter time series foundation model that forecasts multiple related series in a single forward pass. Unlike every TimesFM checkpoint through 2.5, it is pretrained natively for multivariate forecasting, accepting multiple targets, past covariat 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: OpenClaw 发布 OpenClaw 2.0：引导式模型设置、575 毫秒控制 UI 启动以及每个网关一个信任边界
docs.text:
OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway 摘要：OpenClaw 基金会发布了 v2026.8.1，该项目将其称为 OpenClaw 2.0：933 名贡献者、569 名首次参与者和超过 16,000 个拉取请求，大约占合并到存储库中的每个 PR 的一半。安装程序现在重用现有的订阅、API 密钥和本地模型。重建的控制 UI

原文：The OpenClaw Foundation has released v2026.8.1, which the project calls OpenClaw 2.0: 933 contributors, 569 first-timers, and more than 16,000 pull requests, roughly half of every PR ever merged into the repo. Setup now reuses existing subscriptions, API keys and local models. The rebuilt Control UI 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Keenable AI 开源 NEEDLE：每小时重建查询集的实时搜索基准
docs.text:
Keenable AI Open-Sources NEEDLE: A Live Search Benchmark That Rebuilds Its Query Set Every Hour 摘要：当被测试的东西可以读取答案时，如何对网络搜索 API 进行基准测试？搜索代理有一个获取工具。如果黄金标签位于公共数据集中，代理可以在评估过程中下载它们并完全跳过检索。当答案已经编码时会出现类似的问题

原文：How do you benchmark a web search API when the thing being tested can read the answer key? A search agent has a fetch tool. If the gold labels sit in a public dataset, the agent can download them mid-evaluation and skip retrieval entirely. A similar problem arises when the answers are already encode 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: 适用于语音和实时代理的最低延迟推理 API：首次通证时间 TTFT 优先基准
docs.text:
Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark 摘要：语音代理早在智能方面失败之前就因延迟而失败。第一个令牌的时间是大多数团队用来选择推理 API 的指标，它是正确的起点和错误的停止点。该基准测试适用于语音堆栈的每一层 - LLM、语音到文本、文本到文本

原文：Voice agents fail on latency long before they fail on intelligence. Time to first token is the metric most teams use to choose an inference API, and it is the right starting point and the wrong stopping point. This benchmark works through every layer of the voice stack — LLM, speech-to-text, text-to 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.text:
Google AI Introduces EnvHarness: A Programmable Layer That Turns Static Agent Environments Into Adaptive Training Worlds 摘要：谷歌云人工智能研究中心与圣路易斯华盛顿大学和北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校合作，发布了 EnvHarness，这是一个 Apache-2.0 层，可将静态代理基准转变为适应其策略训练的基准。它通过标准的reset()/step()接口包装了一个冻结的环境，所以t

原文：Google Cloud AI Research, with Washington University in St. Louis and UNC Chapel Hill, has released EnvHarness, an Apache-2.0 layer that turns a static agent benchmark into one that adapts to the policy training on it. It wraps a frozen environment through the standard reset()/step() interface, so t 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Anthropic 开放模型硬件标准 (MHS) 的研究预览：AI 代理安全操作物理设备的共享规范
docs.text:
Anthropic Opens a Research Preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS): A Shared Specification for AI Agents to Safely Operate Physical Devices 摘要：Anthropic 开放了模型硬件标准 (MHS) 的研究预览，这是一种共享驱动程序规范，可让 AI 代理发现并安全地操作物理设备。通常需要数周或数月时间的仪器集成减少到数小时：卡内基梅隆大学从原始设备到成品

原文：Anthropic has opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared driver specification that lets AI agents discover and safely operate physical devices. Instrument integration that normally takes weeks or months drops to hours: Carnegie Mellon went from raw equipment to a finish 来源：MarkTechPost

Perplexity Details Its GPU Embedding Stack: How Ivy, Tulip and ROSE Serve pplx-embed 摘要：人工智能搜索产品的检索质量受到两件事的限制：嵌入模型有多好，以及在索引中运行它的成本有多低。本周，Perplexity Engineering 团队发布了《GPU 上的快速嵌入》，这是第二个项目背后的服务基础设施的幕后说明。

原文：Retrieval quality in an AI search product is bounded by two things: how good the embedding model is, and how cheaply you can run it across an index. This week, Perplexity Engineering team published Fast Embeddings on GPUs, an under-the-hood account of the second — the serving infrastructure behind p 来源：MarkTechPost

docs.title: Nous Research 向 Hermes 桌面添加一键式本地模型设置
docs.text:
Nous Research Adds One-Click Local Model Setup to Hermes Desktop 摘要：Nous Research 将本地模型设置压缩为只需在 Hermes Desktop 中单击即可。该应用程序读取您的硬件，根据您的 GPU 检查目录，选择适合的最高质量构建，下载它，并配置 llama.cpp — 具有硬 4 位底层和 64K 最小上下文窗口。这

原文：Nous Research has collapsed local model setup into a single click in Hermes Desktop. The app reads your hardware, fit-checks the catalog against your GPU, picks the highest-quality build that fits, downloads it, and configures llama.cpp — with a hard 4-bit floor and a 64K minimum context window. The 来源：MarkTechPost

GitHub 推出 HydraFusion 项目：运行时多模型编排，可在 Copilot CLI 中为每个编码任务构建工作流程
docs.text:
GitHub Introduces Project HydraFusion: Runtime Multi-Model Orchestration That Builds a Workflow Per Coding Task in Copilot CLI 摘要：我们看看 HydraFusion 项目，这是 GitHub 的研究预览，它将工作流选择视为优化问题而不是模型选择器。我们分解了它之间路由的三种执行模式——单一、带有质量门的级联以及带有只读跨家庭审阅者的批判。这

原文：We look at Project HydraFusion, GitHub's research preview that treats workflow selection as an optimization problem rather than a model picker. We break down the three execution patterns it routes between — Single, Cascade with a quality gate, and Critique with a read-only cross-family reviewer. The 来源：MarkTechPost
